_comment: Bed instances deploy stages wheels for and installs into a venv. Keys are instance names (the <name> in deploy <name>.wheels). Paths may use {source_base} (DEPLOYTOOL_SOURCE_BASE) and {stage} (the instance's stage directory). An optional stage_env names an environment variable that overrides the stage directory for this instance. Fields: account = the OS account that owns the home; group = the group that may write its dist-wheels and venv (the deploy user is a member); account_dist = where the account receives staged wheels and the installer; venv = the venv the installer writes; installer = the installer staged into account_dist; installer_src = the installer's source in the instance repo; build_helper = builds the wheels into stage and rewrites the manifest; stage = the deploy user's staging directory; manifest = the wheel list the installer reads. The bed package is the zoid6 instance: there is no separate bed instance; bed runs in zoid6's account and venv.
